scope: AB/SK non-durum wheat ambient-air aeration; Manitoba untouched
purpose: Concrete prospective verification proposal; not an executable protocol or outreach authorization

proposed.sampling: Include all ten primary top-ranked sites. Divide the remaining eligible ordered ranks into a first ceiling half (middle) and remaining half (lower). Select each non-census stratum by ascending SHA-256 of canonical [seed, stratum, node_id]. Then sample unused disagreement cases followed by unused siting-flagged candidates.
proposed.supplement_shortages: Report available pool, selection and shortfall; do not invent flags or refill from another stratum.
proposed.core_shortages: Stop; no automatic quota reduction or relaxed minimum.
proposed.replacements_after_freeze: none; retain unknown, unreachable and declined contacts
proposed.flags: Supply an approved, evidenced, pre-outcome flag frame. No Phase 4 KILL result is relabelled as a retained model, and no new candidate is silently inserted outside the frozen source frame.
proposed.baselines: Freeze B0, B1, B2, population and expert orders on the same eligible cohort, or record each unavailable arm and reason before outcomes. Do not invent an expert shortlist.
proposed.primary_endpoint: Confirmed screening candidates among the frozen top ten, with the complete top-ten denominator retained. This is a contact/visit prioritisation endpoint, not investment viability.
proposed.unknown_precedence: An unresolved earlier check prevents a later primary outcome from being treated as resolved. Record all observed failure flags separately.
proposed.unresolved_policy: Publish confirmed and resolved counts, a Wilson interval on the resolved fraction, and all-target bounds [confirmed/k, (confirmed+unresolved)/k]. Report precision@k as null until every target is resolved.
proposed.interval: Wilson without continuity correction; describes binomial working-model uncertainty only, not nonresponse bias or spatial dependence.
proposed.comparison: Compare available arms only when the union of their frozen top-ten sets has complete resolved outcomes. Otherwise report incomplete common outcomes and bounds; no winner or pooled population accuracy.
proposed.consent_script: We are assessing whether this location merits further investigation for wheat-storage aeration. Participation is voluntary. May we record your answers privately and use them in aggregate research results? You may decline any question or stop at any time.
proposed.privacy: Keep respondent, assessor, evidence and contact details under ignored data/validation_private; publish aggregates only. A committed participant is referenced by an opaque private identifier.
proposed.temporal_interpretation: Current verification records conditions reported at contact time. It cannot establish historical 2024 operation or validate historical energy values without period-specific evidence. Agree the exact comparison period before field work.

criteria_requiring_human_resolution.node_absent: What evidence and identity/location check establish that the candidate aggregation node does not exist, as distinct from being unreachable or closed temporarily?
criteria_requiring_human_resolution.undocumented_supply: Which compatible aeration assets and capacity evidence contradict the frozen supply interpretation, and when does this constitute a false opportunity? Finding an asset alone need not prove adequate supply.
criteria_requiring_human_resolution.requirement_negligible: Specify the service, inventory/operating evidence and meaningful minimum requirement. No arbitrary kW threshold is supplied.
criteria_requiring_human_resolution.seasonal_irrelevance: Specify the target decision season, usable duty and relevance criterion; seasonality alone is not a failure.
criteria_requiring_human_resolution.confirmed: Define sufficient positive evidence that the site merits technical follow-up, after all preceding checks are resolved; no bankability claim.
